[[Geoffer Pain Bringer]] is an [[Outcast]] [[boss]] that appears in the [[Boreas Seabed (explorable area)|Boreas Seabed]] [[explorable area]].

== Locations ==
* [[The Jade Sea]]
** {{NPC location|Boreas Seabed|explorable area}} (not during [[Protect the Halcyon]])

== Skills ==
* {{skill icon|Axe Rake}}
* {{skill icon|Dismember}}
* {{skill icon|Disrupting Chop}}
* {{skill icon|Shield Bash}}
* {{skill icon|Whirling Axe}} ([[elite]])

== Items dropped ==
* [[Bolt of Cloth]]
* [[Bolt of Silk]]
* [[Bone Charm (trophy)|Bone Charm]]
* [[Geoffer's Bulwark]] ([[unique]])
* [[Outcast Bracers]]

== Notes ==
*If capturing his elite, consider bringing 2 [[Signet of Capture|Signets of Capture]] for [[Dragon Slash]] which can be captured from [[Sskai, Dragon's Birth]], not too far away from Geoffer.
* If you wait, his group will engage a Naga group nearby, usually leading to his death.
